notes.title: PTWH v5.0 Announcement
notes.content:
Hi there guys,
Sorry if I wasn't able to update this game sooner, but a new update is coming soon, and its a BIG IMPROVEMENT!
I'll let you know that this game is going to be remastered fully with new fixes, new models and a new way to stay off from Hoogie's tracks.
I'll update more news about it within the coming weeks before Halloween.

But for now I got Collage, so you know....

notes.title: Playtime with Hoogie v4.0 update
notes.content:
- Fixed a feature where Hoogie will not move from his spawn point
if the 'Disable intros' option is not toggled.

- Added a option feature where you can auto continue the day without having to go the 
main menu.

Any other problems, just let me know :)
